# Windbreaker regression fixture

`windbreaker-sleeves.job.json` contains the two imported size-M outlines named
in the reported overlap: L Sleeve and L Sleeve Under Reflective Panel.
Internal marks were removed; cut outlines and grain lines are unchanged.
